selection: independent calibration conversations; turn cutoff<=budget, no-response<=1%; minimize capped failure delay
limitations: Same reused public English data and overlapping holdouts; no new external evaluation.
Opportunity times are annotated pauses, not a deployed VAD.
ASR is prefix re-decoding with simulated availability and one update per pause, not a streaming recognizer.
Endpointing delay excludes model/ASR compute; cache-cost replay includes only visited decision points.
First response terminates a recorded turn; users cannot react to the agent.
Supervised MLPs use current features and timing; no temporal memory, PPO or emotion labels.
No policy is silently substituted when calibration constraints have no feasible candidate.
Turn-level cutoff is a new metric and cannot be directly equated with previous per-pause cutoff.
